brief:
Hind Rajab Foundation filed a criminal complaint Monday in Slovenia against Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar, Shehab Wire reported. The complaint centers on allegations of genocide crimes committed against Palestinian civilians in Gaza Strip.

The human rights organization formally accused Sa'ar of war crimes as part of its legal strategy to pursue accountability in European courts. The filing marks an effort to use international jurisdictions to investigate alleged violations stemming from the ongoing military operations in Gaza.
